_meta.source: Shogun Showdown wiki, Tiles and Enemies pages (shogunshowdown.wiki.gg), fetched 2026-10-28, CC BY-SA 4.0. Effect texts are paraphrased.

fields.damage, cooldown: [wiki]; null = N/A. Enemy-only tiles carry the cooldown the simulator assumes, tagged in cooldown_source.
fields.skull_cost: [wiki] unlock price in skulls; null = base tile, available without unlocking (the reward pool seen in Bamboo Grove tile choices [bot])
fields.free_play: [wiki] adding the tile to the queue does not pass the turn
fields.attack: machine-readable footprint used by rules.py. kinds: cells (fixed offsets, + = ahead), first (first unit in dir), furthest (furthest unit in dir), damaged (every enemy below max HP), dash_strike (dash in dir to the first unit and strike it), dash_through (dash in dir through units to the first empty cell, striking each), summon, other (not simulated)
fields.sim: true when rules.py simulates the tile; the bot only takes tiles with sim true
fields.ready_value: optional planner bonus for having the tile ready; default 3 x damage + 2 x extra cells (+2 for dashes), see catalogue.ready_value

tiles.name: Katana
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead.

tiles.name: Tetsubo
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead.

tiles.name: Sai
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead; double damage if the target attacks this turn.

tiles.name: Blade of Patience
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead; +1 damage for every turn it stays in the queue.

tiles.name: Hookblade
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead; on a kill, steps forward and strikes again for 1 less damage.

tiles.name: Dragon Punch
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead and pushes the target back; collision damage if it is blocked.

tiles.name: Bo
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly ahead and turns the target around.

tiles.name: Back Strike
tiles.text: Hits the cell directly behind.

tiles.name: Swirl
tiles.text: Hits the cells directly ahead and behind.

tiles.name: Twin Tessen
tiles.text: Hits the cells directly ahead and behind and pushes both targets back; collision damage if blocked.

tiles.name: Spear
tiles.text: Hits the 2 cells directly ahead. Piercing.

tiles.name: Shadow Kama
tiles.text: Hits the cell 2 cells ahead.

tiles.name: Nagiboku
tiles.text: Hits the 2 cells ahead and the 2 cells behind. Piercing. Cannot kill (leaves at least 1 HP).

tiles.name: Earth Impale
tiles.text: Hits the cells 2 ahead and 2 behind.

tiles.name: Meteor Hammer
tiles.text: Hits the first target up to 3 cells ahead; on a hit, bounces back to strike the cell behind the user.

tiles.name: Blazing Suisei
tiles.text: Hits the first target up to 3 cells ahead; on a kill, explodes for 2 damage to adjacent units.

tiles.name: Shuriken
tiles.text: Hits the first target ahead.

tiles.name: Arrow
tiles.text: Hits the first target ahead.

tiles.name: Kunai
tiles.text: Throws as many kunai as its attack value; each deals 1 damage to the first target ahead.

tiles.name: Mon
tiles.text: Hits the first target ahead; spends one coin.

tiles.name: Crossbow
tiles.text: Piercing bolt hits the first two targets ahead; drops to 0 after use and recharges by being used again in an attack.

tiles.name: Grappling Hook
tiles.text: Pulls the first target ahead to the cell directly ahead.

tiles.name: Ki Push
tiles.text: Hits the first target ahead and pushes it back; collision damage if blocked.

tiles.name: Tanegashima
tiles.text: Hits the first target ahead; attacker and target each recoil 1 cell, possibly with collision damage.

tiles.name: Chakram
tiles.text: Hits the first target ahead and behind; +1 damage per enemy death, reset after use.

tiles.name: Lightning
tiles.text: Hits the furthest target ahead.

tiles.name: Scar Strike
tiles.text: Hits every target that is not at full HP.

tiles.name: Trap
tiles.text: Places a trap in the cell ahead; it triggers when a unit steps on it.

tiles.name: Thorns
tiles.text: Creates a 1 HP barrier in the cell ahead.

tiles.name: Charge
tiles.text: Dashes forward and strikes the first target ahead.
tiles.notes: no_target 'edge' is a hypothesis [hyp]: with nothing ahead the user dashes to the last cell. Enemy chargers only fire with the hero in the lane [user], so this only matters for the hero.

tiles.name: Shadow Dash
tiles.text: Dashes forward through targets, stopping at the first empty cell behind them.
tiles.notes: [hyp] each unit dashed through takes the damage; no empty cell behind them = no move, no hit

tiles.name: Smoke Bomb
tiles.text: Swaps position with the first target ahead.

tiles.name: Back Charge
tiles.text: Dashes backward and strikes the first target behind.
tiles.notes: [hyp] facing does not change; no target = dash to the last cell behind

tiles.name: Back Shadow Dash
tiles.text: Dashes backward through targets, stopping at the first empty cell behind them.

tiles.name: Back Smoke Bomb
tiles.text: Swaps position with the first target behind.

tiles.name: Curse
tiles.text: Curses the first target ahead; a cursed target takes double damage from the next hit.

tiles.name: Sharp Turn
tiles.text: Turns around and strikes the cells around the user.

tiles.name: Signature Move
tiles.text: Performs this hero's special move.

tiles.name: Swap Toss
tiles.text: Swaps the contents of the cells directly ahead and behind.

tiles.name: Dash
tiles.text: Dashes forward as far as possible.

tiles.name: Origin of Symmetry
tiles.text: Teleports to the central cell, swapping with a unit standing there.

tiles.name: Mirror
tiles.text: Mirrors the user's position on the board.

tiles.name: Sword
tiles.cooldown_source: hyp: not on the wiki; status.md asks to verify (probably 0, as on the Katana)
tiles.text: Enemy tile: hits the cell directly ahead.
tiles.notes: Ashigaru, Guardian, Grappler, Strider, Shadow Charger and Daisuke carry it [wiki Enemies]; damage 2 [wiki] [obs]

tiles.name: Volley
tiles.text: On declaring the attack, aims at the hero's current cell and strikes it.

tiles.name: Barricade
tiles.text: Builds a barricade in the cell directly ahead.

tiles.name: Summon
tiles.text: Summons an enemy in a random cell.
tiles.notes: Daisuke summons Spike Chargers [wiki]; the cell is random [wiki], the planner assumes the empty cell farthest from the hero [hyp]

tiles.name: Summon (Double Strike)
tiles.text: Summons an enemy in a random cell, twice.

tiles.name: Bomb
tiles.text: Places a bomb in the cell ahead; it explodes after 2 turns.

tiles.name: Shield
tiles.text: Gains a shield that negates the next attack received.

tiles.name: Ally Shield
tiles.text: Gives a shield to the first shieldless ally ahead.

tiles.name: Copycat Mirror
tiles.text: Becomes a basic version of a random hero tile; queued tiles are not copied.

tiles.name: Copycat Mirror (Double Strike)
tiles.text: As Copycat Mirror; the attack is performed twice.

tiles.name: Maku
tiles.text: Drops the curtain and advances to the next act.

tiles.name: Boss Swap
tiles.text: Swaps position with the boss.

tiles.name: Corrupted Barrage
tiles.text: A corruption ring expands one cell per turn; damages units and heals bosses.

tiles.name: Corrupted Wave (Left)
tiles.text: Corruption starts at the left-most cell and moves right each turn; damages units and heals bosses.

tiles.name: Corrupted Wave (Right)
tiles.text: Corruption starts at the right-most cell and moves left each turn; damages units and heals bosses.

tiles.name: Corrupted Explosion
tiles.text: Corrupted explosion that hits every cell.

tiles.name: Corrupted Pulse
tiles.text: Strikes odd cells, then even cells, then odd cells again on successive turns.

tiles.name: Mark
tiles.text: Warden tile; not described on the wiki [gap].
